title: X4 Pro Lua App Control Audit — Grid Mode Applied
description:
46 apps using left/right events have been patched with device.input_mode("grid"). The firmware change adds device.input_mode("nav"|"grid") to the Lua API. In grid mode, the physical Left/Right buttons fire left/right events for cursor-based apps. In nav mode (default), they fire up/down for list scrolling.

Remaining work: SUnny should test each app on hardware to verify the controls make sense on the X4 Pro. Specific things to check:
  1. Grid cursor moves left/right with physical buttons
  2. Confirm via touch/power works
  3. Back via left-edge swipe works
  4. No confirm_hold or back_hold needed (only ble_beacon has up_hold/down_hold, fine)
  5. Touch tap fires confirm (with position via input.pos())
  6. Some apps may still need vertical cursor movement (up/down not available in grid mode)
